acceptanceCriteria: A documented, repeatable command regenerates protocol/cem-1.0/stable/RESULT.schema.json, the S0E repository-envelope-packet expected results and the go1.27.2 structural-tuple packet for an additive stable result member, with checksums and the sealed-case count unchanged.

Applying scratchpad patches p0-stable-citation.patch (native) and p0-portable-stable-citation.patch (portable) plus the regenerated packet makes `len(r) == 22` in TestStableRootPrecedenceBeforeReads, `verification keys=22` in TestStableAssemblySeparateSnapshotIdentityAndFullEnvelope and s0eCompare pass without hand edits to case files.
The regeneration path is cited from docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md and V1-1265 consumes it.
body: Source: V1-1262 lane (decision 0523 P0), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 0 from claude/v1-1262-cem-tiers. Repro: add one member (`citation`) to the cem/1.0 stable result in internal/cem/verify/stable.go and interop/cem01-go/cem.go. Expected: an additive member can be admitted by regenerating the sealed packet. Actual: cem-stable-verification/1 is a 21-key shape sealed by protocol/cem-1.0/stable/RESULT.schema.json (additionalProperties:false), the S0E packet under protocol/cem-1.0/stable/repository-envelope-packet and the go1.27.2 structural tuples (decision 0522); 83 S0E subtests fail and no tool regenerates the packet, so P0 had to defer stable emission to V1-1265 and keep only the 0.x canonical path. Both reverted wirings are saved as patches in the lane scratchpad and described in the V1-1262 PR.
title: cem: no regeneration tooling for the sealed cem/1.0 stable result (RESULT.schema, S0E packet, structural tuples), so additive members such as `citation` cannot land
